Rork  fix members registration  now after I want you to deploy live and verified end to end add otps via sms too IVX ENTERPRISE MEMBER & INVESTOR REGISTRATION
PRIORITY: P0
MODE: IMPLEMENT
OBJECTIVE: Increase member registrations while maintaining enterprise-level compliance for real investors.

DO NOT MIX MEMBER REGISTRATION WITH INVESTOR VERIFICATION.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — MEMBER REGISTRATION
==================================================

Goal:
Allow any user to become an IVX Member in less than 60 seconds.

Required fields only:

• First Name
• Last Name
• Date of Birth
• Gender (Optional)
• Mobile Phone
• Email Address
• Password
• Confirm Password
• Accept Terms & Privacy Policy

Immediately after registration:

• Verify email or mobile (OTP)
• Create Member account
• Create secure session
• Redirect to IVX Home

Member permissions:

✓ Browse investment opportunities
✓ Browse properties
✓ Save favorites
✓ Receive notifications
✓ Use IVX IA Chat
✓ Create profile
✓ Upload profile photo
✓ Follow projects
✓ Join waitlists

Do NOT request:

✗ Driver License
✗ Passport
✗ SSN
✗ Tax documents
✗ Bank information
✗ Income verification
✗ Source of funds
✗ KYC documents
✗ AML verification

These belong ONLY to Phase 2.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — COMPLETE MEMBER PROFILE
==================================================

Accessible after login.

Optional profile information:

• Profile photo
• Address
• City
• State
• ZIP Code
• Country
• Preferred Language
• Investment Interests
• Buyer
• Investor
• JV Partner
• Tokenized Investor

Completion percentage:

25%
50%
75%
100%

Users may skip and return later.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — REAL INVESTOR VERIFICATION
==================================================

This phase starts ONLY when the member clicks:

"Start Investing"

or

"Invest Now"

or

"Participate in this Deal"

==================================================
IDENTITY VERIFICATION
==================================================

• Government ID
• Driver License or Passport
• Live Selfie
• Liveness Detection

==================================================
ADDRESS VERIFICATION
==================================================

• Address
• City
• State
• ZIP Code
• Country

==================================================
KYC / AML
==================================================

• Identity verification
• AML screening
• Sanctions screening
• Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screening
• Risk score

==================================================
TAX INFORMATION
==================================================

US Investors

• SSN or ITIN
• W-9

International Investors

• Passport
• W-8BEN or applicable tax form

==================================================
FINANCIAL INFORMATION
==================================================

Only when legally required.

• Source of Funds
• Employment Status
• Investment Experience
• Net Worth (if required)
• Accredited Investor status (if applicable)

==================================================
INVESTMENT AGREEMENTS
==================================================

Before first investment:

• Electronic Signature
• Subscription Agreement
• Operating Agreement
• Investment Risk Disclosure
• Terms Acceptance

==================================================
BANK VERIFICATION
==================================================

Before funding investments:

• Bank Account Verification
• ACH / Wire Verification
• Payment Method Validation

==================================================
STATUS LEVELS
==================================================

LEVEL 1
Member Registered

Can:

✓ Browse IVX
✓ Use IVX IA Chat
✓ Save favorites
✓ Receive notifications

Cannot invest.

--------------------------------------

LEVEL 2
Verified Investor

Can:

✓ Invest
✓ Sign legal documents
✓ Transfer funds
✓ Participate in JV Deals
✓ Invest in Tokenized Assets
✓ View investment dashboard
✓ Track portfolio

==================================================
UX REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

The registration process must feel as simple as Instagram or LinkedIn.

Target completion time:

Phase 1:
Under 60 seconds

Phase 2:
Optional

Phase 3:
Only when required before investing.

==================================================
ENTERPRISE REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

• Never request legal documents during member registration.
• Never block users from exploring the platform.
• Perform KYC/AML only before accepting investments.
• Save progress automatically.
• Allow users to resume verification later.
• Mobile-first design.
• Enterprise-grade security.
• Full audit trail.
• End-to-end encrypted personal documents.
• Owner-configurable KYC workflow.
• Full logging of verification status.
• Deep QA of every registration path.
• Zero data loss.
• Zero duplicate accounts.
• Production verified before deployment.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

✓ Fast member registration
✓ High conversion rate
✓ Enterprise-grade investor verification
✓ Excellent user experience
✓ Regulatory compliance
✓ Production-ready implementation
